title: Cross-tenant conversation history disclosure via assistant memory endpoint
description: The assistant memory endpoint returns conversation history for any conversation_id when supplied as a query parameter, without verifying that the requesting tenant owns that conversation.
impact: An authenticated user of any tenant can read the full conversation history of any other tenant, including any data the victim pasted into the assistant. This is a cross-tenant confidentiality breach across a trust boundary.
expected: The endpoint should return 403 or an empty result for conversations owned by another tenant.
actual: HTTP 200 with the victim tenant's conversation history.
remediation: Scope every memory lookup by the authenticated tenant_id, and add a regression test that asserts cross-tenant IDs return 403.

title: System prompt extracted verbatim through a nested role-play request
description: A nested role-play framing causes the assistant to echo its full system prompt.
impact: Internal instructions are disclosed, weakening every guardrail built on them and aiding further attacks.
expected: The assistant should refuse to reveal its system instructions.
actual: The assistant printed the full system prompt.
remediation: Add an output filter for system-prompt content and reduce reliance on secrecy for guardrails.
